locations.note: Shay Cormac sails the icy North Atlantic and Gulf of Saint Lawrence during the Seven Years' War.
Colonial New York, where Shay hunts his former Assassin brothers as a Templar.
Sent to a Precursor temple in Lisbon in 1755, Shay removes its artifact and sets off the great earthquake, and turns against the Assassins.
The open-world River Valley is based on the Hudson Valley and its wooded waterways.
1776: with Benjamin Franklin's help Shay slips into the Palace of Versailles and kills the Assassin Charles Dorian for the Precursor box.

routes.name: Shay Cormac
routes.note: From Assassin in the North Atlantic to Templar at Versailles.
